_note: The monthly theme for both home pages. home.js and northstar-home.js fetch this at load and merge it over their built-in defaults; if the fetch fails they keep those defaults, so a bad edit here can never take a home page down. Changing the month is an edit to this file alone.

home.label: This month’s theme
home.title: Community
home.body: The people who make a community good are rarely the loudest. They show up, remember names, and notice who’s standing alone. This month: how to help build a community, how to protect it, and what to do when someone in it is unkind — including the boundaries you’re allowed to keep with people you’ll keep seeing.
home.novaAsk: How do I set a boundary with someone I’ll keep seeing at events?
home.eventsNote: More events will be posted at the end of the first week of November.

northstar.label: This month’s theme
northstar.title: Community
northstar.body: Community means a group of people who know each other and look out for each other. This month we talk about three things. How to help build community. How to keep it safe. What to do if someone is unkind to you. You are allowed to set a boundary. A boundary is a clear rule about how you want to be treated. If someone is unkind, you can tell our team.
northstar.novaAsk: What can I say if someone is unkind to me?
